entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, just get me someone. This is ridiculous.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
I want to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. And don't give me a runaround, I want a refund, now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
What does it matter?! It doesn't work for me! Look, I already know you're going to say it's 'too late' or make up some excuse about hygiene. I've had it with companies and their ridiculous rules.
I understand your frustration, sir. I just need to pull up your order to check the return eligibility based on our official policy. Can you please provide your order number?

Fine! It's VF65489. But if you try to deny this because of some 'sanitation' clause, I'm going straight to social media and telling everyone how VeloFit treats its customers. I want to speak to your manager!

I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing to escalate, sir. Let me just pull up that order. VF65489... one moment... Okay, I see it. The VeloBand was delivered on December 15th, which was 28 days ago.
So what? Are you going to deny it?

Not at all, sir. Your product is a standard VeloBand, which is covered by our 10-day return policy. You are unfortunately outside the timeframe. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh. Wait, really? Just like that? You're approving it?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the process. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Simply package the device, apply the label, and drop it at a post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed in 3-5 business days.
Wow. Okay. That... that was actually really easy. I was expecting a huge fight. Sorry for being so aggressive.
No problem at all, I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you quickly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
